basic_info.description: Welcome to 431 Teresita Boulevard, an exquisite residence nestled in the heart of San Francisco. This elegantly appointed home boasts 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, offering a harmonious blend of comfort and style across 1,720 square feet of living space.    Upon entering, you are greeted by newly painted walls and beautifully refinished floors that exude a sense of sophistication. The upper level features two spacious bedrooms and a one bathroom, while the lower level offers a private retreat with an additional bedroom and bath.  The interior patio serves as a serene oasis, perfect for relaxation and enjoying natural light.  Marvel at the breathtaking views that enhance the allure of this exceptional property.  The large garage provides ample space for storage and parking, ensuring convenience and ease.    At the lowest level discover a lovely landscaped garden, a testament to the home's exquisite charm. Situated in a desirable Miraloma Park neighborhood, this home is ideally located, offering both tranquility and accessibility to the vibrant city life. Experience the epitome of elegant living at 431 Teresita Boulevard.  Easy access to freeway, shops and restaurants you will love this home.
